meta_description: Dickey Wrecker Service serving Murphy - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Careful towing in Murphy, start to finish.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
explore_h2: If it will not move, we will move it
quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the vehicle
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Murphy and the towns around it.
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.

services.title: Car and light truck transport

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads

reviews.author: Kimberly Keough
reviews.text: Super nice and respectful man. My car died at the Konehete park in Murphy. It was 2 am and he rolled right out of bed to come and jump my car at a fair price. Even gave me some tips and told me what I should do next to avoid the issue in the future. I would 100% recommend this man to any friends or family in need of a tow service.

reviews.author: kimber keough
reviews.text: Super nice and respectful man. My car died at konehete park in Murphy. It was 2am when I called and he rolled right out of bed to come and jump my car, at a fair price as well. He even gave me some tips on what I should do to avoid the issue in the future. I would 100% recommend this business to anyone in need of a tow service.

reviews.author: Donald Hale
reviews.text: Christian man, helps whoever he can, when he can. The community should support all his tireless efforts and willingness to help where others won't tread. Proud to support his walk with the lord. Go and see the merchandise for sale, and hospitality. Thank you.

reviews.author: John Leistner
reviews.text: I got into a bind and got stuck in the mud. Being from put of town, I didn't know what to expect but my experience was better than I could have expected. Prices were reasonable, he was here promptly, and professional and personable. It took 15 minutes. He also helped with a few other things that came with being stuck in the mud. 5/5 I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Keith Van Campen
reviews.text: He either didn't understand where the tow was going.. or never looked it up. Once we arrived at the delivery location he insisted on an additional $20, or he was going to return the vehicle to the pick up location, and was extremely rude about it, complaining about the hill, and his truck running hot. It was explained during the initial phone call where the truck would be delivered, and a price was given. We would not recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Henry Smith
reviews.text: They were prompt, courteous and absolutely competent. The service I received was great. I will definitely use them again. And would recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Janet Ross
reviews.text: Efficient Wrecker Service! Called & they showed up. Called on phone & received fantastic phone help, very polite & nice! Would use again. Very Satisfied!

reviews.author: John D. C
reviews.text: They answer the phone. Which is always good. If they have no trucks available (Which is often), they will refer you to another towing service.

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.text: Saved the day. Jeep and trailer were on the side of the mountain. They were professional and friendly. Would highly recommend.
